data.one_liner: Disables the native web context menu for a specific Flutter widget
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that prevents the default browser context menu from appearing when right-clicking a specific child widget on Flutter Web. On non-web platforms, it acts as a pass-through and does nothing.
use_when: You want to show a custom Flutter context menu on web for a specific widget instead of the global browser menu.
You need your web app to be WASM compatible.
avoid_when: You want to disable the context menu globally across the entire app (which can be done via Flutter's built-in BrowserContextMenu).
Your app does not target Flutter Web.
strengths: Targeted disabling of context menus for specific widgets rather than globally.
Safe to use across all platforms as it safely no-ops on non-web targets.
weaknesses: Limited to solving a single specific web-only UI problem.
data.minimal_example:
DisableWebContextMenu(
  child: Container(
    width: 200,
    height: 200,
    child: Text('Right click to show custom menu'),
  ),
)
